Freshers as well as candidates with 1 to more years' experience in handling electronics (digital analogue), power supply and control circuits are eligible.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TIFR Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the TIFR Research Assistant recruitment is 22nd October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Full-Time Science Graduate degree in Physics and/or Electronics or a Full-time Diploma in Electronics Engineering or related fields, both with at least 60% marks. Knowledge of personal computers is also necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Research Assistant position is 25 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TIFR Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q8. Can freshers apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers are eligible to apply for the Research Assistant position. Candidates with 1 to more years of experience in handling electronics are also encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q9. What documents do I need to attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of your educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs with your application.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for TIFR Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
